title: Rich text editor (Tiptap/ProseMirror) does not release focus on Escape keypress (WCAG 2.1.2)
requirementSource: WCAG 2.1 SC 2.1.2 (No Keyboard Trap) — if keyboard focus can be moved to a component, focus can also be moved away from that component using only a keyboard interface; if this requires more than unmodified arrow or tab keys, the user is advised of the method
stepsToReproduce: Navigate to Terms and Conditions page (/locations/1604/settings/terms-conditions).
Click into a row's rich text editor cell to open the Tiptap/ProseMirror editor (contenteditable="true" div).
Type any text to confirm the editor has focus and is operational.
Observe: the return value is still "true" — focus has not left the editor.
expectedBehavior: Pressing Escape should move focus out of the editor to a logical parent element (e.g., the table cell, the row, or a toolbar). After Escape, document.activeElement should NOT be the contenteditable div.
actualBehavior: Focus stays inside the editor's contenteditable div after Escape. document.activeElement.getAttribute('contenteditable') returns "true". The editor does nothing observable on Escape — focus remains trapped. Expected: not "true". Received: "true".

baselineEvidence: The Tiptap/ProseMirror rich text editor is a new-site-only component. The old site does not use inline rich text editing for terms and conditions content. No old-site equivalent exists.
